title: DoseSeries (docs/specs/05 §C.2 DoseSeries, dose_series.json)
$comment: Replayed surface absorbed dose rate (02 L9, §D.13). Written by pipeline rad.py (T21.07) or the digitised fallback (T21.13). The Hab Core loader checks this file's SHA-256 against scenario.json tables.dose_series (05 §E.7). 'Strictly increasing time' in samples cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; the pipeline test (T21.03, pipeline/tests/test_rad.py) checks it.

series_id.description: Series id; "rad-sol4190" for the storm-sol4190 scenario (05 DoseSeries).

unit.description: Absorbed dose rate; never Sv for the event (05 DoseSeries, 02 L9).

samples.description: [t_utc, rate] pairs. Time strictly increasing (not expressible here; checked by T21.03). rate is null for a gap; the Hab Core step-holds between samples and does not interpolate across null gaps (05 §E.7).

prefixItems.description: rate in uGy/h; null marks a gap.

background_rate.description: Background rate in the same unit (uGy/h); used for the RADIATION_ALERT trigger (02 §D.13).

integral_check.description: For digitised/template_scaled, expected_ugy is the published total (05 DoseSeries); for archive, T21.07 takes expected from the published total and computed from the samples.
